Final scores are binary 20‑bit numbers, each appears once. Winners at each node = any subset of size half satisfying w_i>l_i → Catalan_n ways (n=group/2).  
N=∏_{j=0}^{19} Catalan_{2^j}^{2^{19‑j}}.  
Compute v₂(N)=Σ2^{19‑j}·v₂(C_{2^j}), v₅(N)=Σ2^{19‑j}·v₅(C_{2^j}) via Legendre: v_p(C_n)=v_p((2n)!)-v_p((n+1)!)-v_p(n!).  
Result: v₂=524287, v₅=121818 → k=min=121818.  
Answer k mod 10⁵ = 21818.  

Pitfalls: assume any half‑subset works → need Catalan count; ensure depth‑20 tree, internal nodes count 2^d. Use big ints.
